item.title: Video: P!nk Visits & JULIET For Kandi Burruss' Final Performance
item.description: P!nk stopped by & Juliet to see friend and former collaborator Kandi Burruss' final performance. Burruss took her final bow as 'Angelique' in the hit Broadway show on Saturday. item.title: OPERATION MINCEMEAT Extends for an Eighth Time on Broadway
item.description: Tony and Olivier Award-winning musical Operation Mincemeat, originally scheduled to run for just 16 weeks on Broadway, has been extended for an eighth time, adding 18 more weeks through January 17, 2027, due to popular demand. Exclusively for superfans on the mailing list, the “Operation Earlybird” pre-sale begins on Thursday, March 26, running for 24 hours.
